body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> ATEC presented 42-inch full HD LCD TV adopting LG-Philips'' SUper-IPS panel. The company had also launched 47-inch full LCD TV before.
In connection to a pc, this 42-inch model supports 1920x1080 resolution and its two HDMI ports are there to receive 1080p images from other digital sources.

''Surround function'' enables users to experience more realistic sound of the stage on the screen while ''automatic volume control function'' automatically adjusts the loudness of sound properly that are usually different depending on a broadcasting company.
The company is going to display its large-size TV lineup at the upcoming CES 2007 including the 42-inch full HD TV.
